metadata.description: Ambareesha Vittal's Claude Code plugins: rvr, idd, spotify and prs.

plugins.name: rvr
plugins.description: Research, Validate, Report: end a message with rvr to pressure-test a design before you commit to it.

plugins.name: idd
plugins.description: Ideate, Debate, Discuss: end a message with idd and Claude only discusses and plans, with no code changes.

plugins.name: spotify
plugins.description: Icon-only Spotify controls above the prompt, with a fullscreen sidebar for browsing and playing your playlists.

plugins.name: prs
plugins.description: Dock a pull request review (diff, file tree, commits) beside your session via /prs, for Azure DevOps or GitHub.
